tasks.title: Timezone-aware event order
tasks.instruction: Repair solution.solve(events), returning event IDs in chronological order. Each event has id and at, an ISO8601 timestamp with Z or an explicit UTC offset. Equal instants retain input order. Reject timezone-naive timestamps with ValueError. Edit solution.py only.

files.solution.py:
def solve(events):
 return [item["id"] for item in sorted(events,key=lambda item:item["at"])]

tasks.title: Bounded retry schedule
tasks.instruction: Repair solution.solve(attempts, base, cap). Return exactly attempts exponential delays starting at base, doubling each time, capped at cap. Zero attempts returns an empty list. Negative attempts or negative base/cap raise ValueError. Zero base/cap are valid. Edit solution.py only.

files.solution.py:
def solve(attempts, base, cap):
 return [max(cap,base*2**i) for i in range(attempts+1)]

tasks.title: Exact invoice cents
tasks.instruction: Repair solution.solve(amounts). Amounts are decimal strings. Round EACH amount to two decimal places using ROUND_HALF_UP, convert to integer cents, then sum. Negative credits use the same rule. Empty input returns 0. Do not use floating-point arithmetic. Edit solution.py only.

files.solution.py:
def solve(amounts):
 return int(sum(float(amount) for amount in amounts)*100)
